Name: Prosthetics & Androids Expanded (v0.15 Update)
Description:
[h3]NOT COMPATIBLE WITH V0.14![/h3]

Adds prosthetic, bionic, and android body parts for both humans and androids.

This is a Stardeus v0.15 compatibility update of the original Prosthetics & Androids Expanded mod. The purpose of this release is to restore functionality broken by game updates while preserving the original author's design and gameplay intent wherever possible.

[h2]Restored and updated functionality includes:[/h2]
• Stardeus v0.15 compatibility updates
• Surgical UI compatibility support
• Android body and sprite restoration
• Android work capability restoration
• Obey Chip research progression restoration
• Quantum Nexus support for Mind Transfer and Machine Learning
• Quantum Nexus personality generation for newly created Android minds
• Weighted Android traits: usually one, sometimes two, and rarely three
• Robotic traits favored over emergent personalities and physiological defects
• Existing traitless Androids receive traits once when an older save is loaded
• Android traits remain bound to the mind through save/load and Nexus transfer
• Male and female hair generation for newly created Androids
• Visible Android clothing, hats, helmets, suits, and other equipped apparel
• Android roles and suitable professional backgrounds, including a one-time update for existing Androids
• Android participation in passenger quests and selected appropriate factions
• Android generation in stasis arrays, survivor groups, derelicts, selected traders and gifts, and combat-raid fallbacks
• Automatic Install Missing Parts and Replace Bad Parts support for compatible Android body parts
• Android Head and Android Frame retained for Android creation but removed from crafting and trade
• Definition, market, research, and validation fixes
• Removal of deprecated or unsupported data structures
• Removal of Work Ability ID from Androids
• Adjusted PowerHand attack charge speeds to conform to Core requirements
• Reimplemented sexes, orientations, and attractions
• Fixed lack of blood issue
• Adjusted Tier for all MakeShift parts - these are not as good as what you're born with and shouldn't be on the same Tier as them
• Updated Degeneracy Reactor hunger modifier to avoid zero-value Hunger stat updates
• Preserves near-total hunger reduction while preventing AddToBaseWithCompoundLimit warning spam
• Fixed Entropy Exchanger's attack rate so that it falls within the bounds of the game's mechanics
• General compatibility and stability improvements

[h2]Version 2.3.3:[/h2]
• Migrated Android population generation to the Stardeus rc332 stasis-manifest and survivor-selection systems
• Restored the intended Android share for new stasis sleepers, survivor groups, derelict inhabitants, selected gifts, and combat-raid fallbacks
• Existing and preset stasis sleepers retain their saved identities
• Removed obsolete BleedChance properties now ignored by Core's wound system
• Added population patch diagnostics to expose future Core incompatibilities instead of silently skipping them

[h2]Version 2.3.2:[/h2]
• Updated Android mental needs for the Stardeus rc294 species changes
• Mental Health and Fun now remain correctly associated with the Android mind through body and Quantum Nexus transfers

[h2]Version 2.3.1:[/h2]
• Restored Android raid participation for Adventurer, Old Earth, Pirate, and Scavenger factions after the rc290 raid-generation changes
• Retained the existing Android selection weight and Core raid scaling, equipment, and flight checks
• Updated the Android emergency raid fallback to the current spawning method

[h2]Balance adjustment:[/h2]
• Nanite Hive (Kidney): The original healing and blood-clot rate created effectively undying raiders. Its values were reduced substantially. It remains roughly ten times better than the default organ without making its carrier practically immortal.
